source_title: Tata Sons debate: Listed middle layer NBFCs have higher advances as NPAs - Business Standard
source_excerpt: As Tata Sons resists the Reserve Bank of India’s mandatory public listing rules for upper layer non-banking financial companies, a comparison of financial data reveals a paradox: While the regulator’s scrutiny of giant business groups makes news, the real concentration of bad loan stress actually sits among listed middle layer NBFCs. This is when bad assets are counted as proportion to advances. In abolute terms, listed upper layer NBFCs have higher risks.
